spec: draft-bryce-cose-receipts-mmr-profile-00 SS6/SS7 accumulator, canonical-CBOR array-of-bstr encoding (capsule-emit [cll-commitment-interop])
encoding: CBOR definite-length array of definite-length 32-byte strings (RFC 8949 SS4.2 deterministic encoding), one element per accumulator peak hash, ordered tallest-to-smallest (descending height).

cases.name: empty-accumulator
cases.description: MMR with zero peaks (empty log) -- commitment is the empty CBOR array.

cases.name: kat39-mmr-index-0-single-leaf-peak
cases.description: Peak set at KAT39 mmr_index=0 (datatrails/go-datatrails-merklelog draft_kat39_test.go, cross-checked by tests/checkpoint/test_mmr_kat39.py) -- 1 peak(s).

cases.name: kat39-mmr-index-3-two-peaks
cases.description: Peak set at KAT39 mmr_index=3 (datatrails/go-datatrails-merklelog draft_kat39_test.go, cross-checked by tests/checkpoint/test_mmr_kat39.py) -- 2 peak(s).

cases.name: kat39-mmr-index-10-three-peaks-mixed-height
cases.description: Peak set at KAT39 mmr_index=10 (datatrails/go-datatrails-merklelog draft_kat39_test.go, cross-checked by tests/checkpoint/test_mmr_kat39.py) -- 3 peak(s).

cases.name: kat39-mmr-index-18-three-peaks
cases.description: Peak set at KAT39 mmr_index=18 (datatrails/go-datatrails-merklelog draft_kat39_test.go, cross-checked by tests/checkpoint/test_mmr_kat39.py) -- 3 peak(s).

cases.name: kat39-mmr-index-25-four-peaks
cases.description: Peak set at KAT39 mmr_index=25 (datatrails/go-datatrails-merklelog draft_kat39_test.go, cross-checked by tests/checkpoint/test_mmr_kat39.py) -- 4 peak(s).

cases.name: kat39-mmr-index-38-three-peaks-tail
cases.description: Peak set at KAT39 mmr_index=38 (datatrails/go-datatrails-merklelog draft_kat39_test.go, cross-checked by tests/checkpoint/test_mmr_kat39.py) -- 3 peak(s).

cases.name: reversed-peak-order
cases.description: Same 4 peak hashes as kat39-mmr-index-25-four-peaks but in reversed (ascending-height) order -- violates the required descending-height ordering.
cases.reason: peak order must be descending-height (tallest first); this encodes ascending order instead

cases.name: dropped-trailing-peak
cases.description: Only the first 3 of the 4 peaks at kat39-mmr-index-25 -- an incomplete accumulator.
cases.reason: commitment encodes only 3 of the 4 true peaks

cases.name: duplicated-trailing-peak
cases.description: The 4 true peaks at kat39-mmr-index-25 plus a duplicate of the last one appended -- an over-long accumulator.
cases.reason: commitment encodes 5 peaks, one of them a duplicate not present in the true accumulator

cases.name: bit-flipped-peak
cases.description: Same 4 peaks as kat39-mmr-index-25 but the first byte of the second peak hash has one bit flipped.
cases.reason: one peak hash byte does not match the true accumulator

cases.name: indefinite-length-array-encoding
cases.description: The true 4 peaks at kat39-mmr-index-25, CBOR-encoded with an indefinite-length array header instead of the required definite-length (RFC 8949 SS4.2 deterministic) form. Same logical content, non-canonical bytes.
cases.reason: uses an indefinite-length CBOR array header; the conformant encoding is always definite-length
